label: Frame Buffer
description: A memory buffer that stores pixel data for rendering images on screen.

label: Render Loop
description: The continuous cycle of updating and drawing graphics each frame.

label: Shader
description: A small program executed on the GPU to control vertex or pixel processing.

label: Vertex
description: A point in 2D or 3D space used to define geometry.

label: Fragment
description: A potential pixel generated during rasterization, processed by fragment shaders.

label: Rasterization
description: The process of converting vector graphics (triangles) into pixels on the screen.

label: Texture
description: An image applied to geometry to add detail and realism.

label: UV Mapping
description: The process of projecting a 2D texture onto a 3D surface.

label: Lighting
description: Simulation of light sources to affect the appearance of objects.

label: Phong Shading
description: A shading technique that interpolates surface normals for smooth lighting.

label: Z-Buffer
description: A depth buffer used to determine which objects are visible in a scene.

label: Anti-Aliasing
description: A technique to reduce jagged edges in rendered images.

label: GPU
description: Graphics Processing Unit, specialized hardware for parallel rendering tasks.

label: Pipeline
description: The sequence of stages (vertex, rasterization, fragment) used to render graphics.

label: Ray Tracing
description: A rendering technique that simulates light rays for realistic reflections and shadows.

label: Frame Rate
description: The number of frames rendered per second, affecting smoothness of animation.

label: Double Buffering
description: Using two frame buffers to prevent flickering and tearing during rendering.

label: V-Sync
description: Vertical synchronization to align frame rendering with display refresh rate.

label: Scene Graph
description: A hierarchical structure representing objects and transformations in a scene.

label: Tessellation
description: The process of subdividing geometry into finer detail for rendering.
